exposure: Maternal leisure time physical activity at four stages: the year before pregnancy and during the first, second, and third trimester
outcome: Mode of delivery (emergency caesarean section, vacuum extractor, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
cohort: 2,435 nulliparous women who delivered a singleton infant in cephalic presentation at term after spontaneous onset of labor in Denmark between 2004-2005
finding: Increasing leisure time physical activity before and during pregnancy was associated with a less complicated delivery among low-risk, nulliparous women.
mod_finding: The odds of emergency caesarean section decreased with increasing levels of physical activity, with statistically significant trends at all four time stages except the third trimester.
